_readme: Optional search hints. Nothing here selects a voice or grants any right.
Some upstream search APIs index an artist under a different spelling than
the one people say out loud (for example a Chinese name vs. a Latin stage
name). Add those spellings here and the search layer will try them too.
Leave 'aliases' empty and the search layer behaves as if the file was absent.
This file is local configuration: keep your own entries out of version control
if they identify a private or unlicensed track.
